items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Here's Meyer and Amil Garren playing the Cali-O.

ctx.x: I never did like the sound on the press. To tell you the truth.
It's something they don't use anymore. It's a cymbal on the side. Yeah. And this was the old fashioned foot pedal. Here's the JS. The JS. Here's Meyer and Amil Garren playing the Cali-O.
How do you want me to make the check out? For what? For doing this.
